documents.title: AI Guidance for Faculty
documents.date_or_term: current (accessed 2026-10-25); guidance in effect since fall 2023
documents.quality_note: Instructor-choice guidance with three sample syllabus statements (no allowance, allowance with restriction, allowance without restriction); refers department/college specifics to the Department Chair. The 'Supplementary Materials' document it links to was not fetched.

documents.title: Memorandum: Valuable Resources on AI for Faculty
documents.quality_note: Provost memo stating that each faculty member needs to set their classroom AI policy in their syllabus and pointing to the AI Task Force website's draft statements. Only a few rule sentences; the site it refers to was not located.

documents.title: Artificial Intelligence Guidelines (graduate capstone, thesis, DNP project, dissertation)
documents.quality_note: Substantive: disclosure requirement, acceptable uses, listed misuses, consequences up to dismissal. Applies to graduate culminating work only; colleges/departments are encouraged to write their own, defaulting to these.

notes: No school/college or computing-unit (CS, data science, etc.) AI policy found by search; the ETL guidance defers to department chairs for such policies. The UAH AI Task Force website (University Statement on AI, syllabus statements) referenced in the 2023 provost memo and the ETL 'Supplementary Materials' document were not located. A 2023 news item (uah.edu/news/items/17988) exists but is news, not collected. Courses deferred.
